items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: Do you recognize the name Bob Frank? Bob? ... Remember piccolo player, he played like that. I don't know how piccolo player played.

ctx.x: And he has one time for him. So he got to work around. I have to sit that night on the door. Right now. Sometimes I speak to Balaybola. Yeah, that's true. He called his sweetheart, and he loved the children. That was a nice... Yeah.
After the ball is over, that was another ball.
